continuity.arc_goal: Implement complete linked services system across three phases: Phase A (object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade), Phase A.2 (refactor completion model from LinkedFrom-as-sink to unified response_sinks on both VO and WI; eliminate LinkCompletionSink type), Phase B (workflow invocation linking with InvocationEdges, StartLinkedCommand, coupled link+invocation semantics, InvocationStatus::Completing, and full link matrix: VO↔VO, VO↔WI, WI↔VO, WI↔WI). All phases functionally complete; this session applies naming convention cleanup and prepares for PR.

progress_update.summary: We completed a naming convention refactor across the entire linked-services codebase, replacing parent/child/local/remote field names with directional link_to/link_from (creating) and linked_to/linked_from (established) semantics. Also created a separate branch (refactor/rpc-response-extraction) for an unrelated RPC response extraction cleanup, and fixed a pre-existing broken commit by adding the missing edge_encoding.rs module.
progress_update.goal: Complete linked services implementation (Phases A, A.2, B) with clean naming, then prepare for PR. All phases functionally complete — remaining work is naming cleanup, full workspace validation, and PR prep.
accomplished: Audited ~350+ runtime guards for impossible states across the codebase (unreachable!, panic!, debug_assert!, bail!) — documented findings in plan file

Created refactor/rpc-response-extraction branch with centralized RPC response extraction methods on PartitionProcessorRpcResponse — eliminates 9 scattered panic sites and fixes a copy-paste bug in purge_journal

Renamed all link struct fields: LinkRequest.{link_to,link_from}, LinkResponse.{linked_from,linked_to}, UnlinkRequest.{linked_to,linked_from}, UnlinkResponse.linked_from, LinkCompletionNotification.{linked_from,linked_to}, ServiceLinkNotification.linked_from, InvocationLinkNotification.linked_from
Renamed retain_non_parent_sinks → retain_non_linked_from_sinks, encode_remote/decode_remote → encode_entity/decode_entity, and all parent_*/child_* local variables to link convention
Fixed pre-existing broken commit: added missing edge_encoding.rs module with encode_entity/decode_entity functions
progress_update.now: All naming convention changes committed (7e5151c3d). 36/36 linked-services tests pass. Two untracked doc files remain (rename_tasks.md, task_context_rename.md).

constraints: Proto field numbers unchanged — wire format backward compatible
Tense convention: link_to/link_from for creating, linked_to/linked_from for established
No suffixes on field names — Rust types carry the 'what'
edge_encoding.rs is a stub implementation — may need verification against original intent
Phase A behaviors preserved: cycle detection, GC cascade, external state mutation guard, stale edge cleanup, JSON failure encoding in onCompleted handler
VirtualObjectStatus::Completed is type-enforced terminal (no response_sinks field)
LinkedFrom edges are presence-only — all callback data lives in target entity's response_sinks
WI unlinker MUST NOT filter response_sinks (would break WI blocking on attach sink)
has_links flag on InFlightInvocationMetadata still gates RocksDB scans in end_invocation
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None, Duration fields unwrap_or_default)
ServiceCompletionTarget carries retention_duration and journal_retention_duration for spawned handlers
decisions: Tense encodes link lifecycle stage: link_* = creating, linked_* = established fact
No suffixes: linked_from: ServiceId not linked_from_service_id — type system provides disambiguation
decode_edge_key_value returns generic 'entity' not 'linked_to' — the caller's scan context determines semantics
RPC response extraction refactor split to separate branch (refactor/rpc-response-extraction) since it's unrelated to linking
Kill/cancel of Completing invocations force-completes using stored result via resume_completing_invocation — children keep running independently but parent is unblocked
1-hop cycle detection accepted as initial tradeoff — documenting limitation rather than implementing bounded BFS

Option A: store retention on ServiceCompletionTarget sink rather than threading through send_response_to_sinks at every call site — semantically correct (linker owns retention), eliminates parameter-threading bug class entirely
CompleteServiceCommand now uses linker's retention (via sink) not completer's — resolves the semantic ambiguity
Single canonical definition for remote_type in service_edges_table, re-exported by invocation_edges_table
Unified response sinks on both VO and WI entity types rather than maintaining two dispatch pipes (LinkedFrom-based for VO completion, response_sinks for WI)
VirtualObjectStatus::Locked/Unlocked gain inline response_sinks as struct variants; Completed has no sinks field (type-enforced terminal state)
Two link establishment paths: Path A (LinkServiceCommand → LinkRequest round-trip) for existing children; Path B (StartLinkedCommand → ServiceInvocation.link_from piggyback) for new WI children
Already-completed target short-circuits: on_link_request fires handler immediately with stored result, emits LinkCompletionNotification for edge transition, sends LinkResponse(Ok)
Option A split for unlink commands: UnlinkServiceCommand (VO target) / UnlinkInvocationCommand (WI target) — type-level split at command layer only
Two edge tables: ServiceEdges (VO parents, service-level) + InvocationEdges (WI parents, invocation-scoped)
ServiceEdgeState uses proto oneof to unify edge label + state — no separate edge_label param on put_service_edge
onCompleted handler encodes failure details as JSON in typed FailurePayload (not format-string) — safe for special characters
